recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 淋巴結中，大小相近的結節背靠背密集排列，並越過淋巴結包膜延伸到周圍脂肪組織中，淋巴結正常結構被取代；結節性增生加上被膜外侵犯是濾泡性淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic nodules effacing the nodal architecture
Nodules of relatively uniform size with ill-defined or absent mantle zones
Extension of the nodular lymphoid infiltrate into perinodal adipose tissue
Thin fibrous bands separating nodules; scant interfollicular tissue
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node and perinodal tissue shows effacement of architecture by closely packed, back-to-back lymphoid nodules of fairly uniform size. The nodular infiltrate extends beyond the capsule into perinodal fat. Mantle zones are poorly defined, and cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed with cytology and immunohistochemistry (CD10, BCL2, CD21).

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have preserved mantle zones and polarization, remain within the capsule, and lack germinal center BCL2 expression.
MCL nodules are composed of monotonous small cells that are CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.
NMZL expands marginal zones around residual reactive follicles with CD10-negative monocytoid cells.
